sources.title: 令和6(2024)年簡易生命表
sources.definition: nqx is the conditional probability that a life-table survivor at exact age x dies before x+n; qx is not a crude population death rate. lx starts from a hypothetical 100000 live births. The selected annual rows have n=1 for ages0-104; the age105 row has n=infinity, not one year.
sources.population: Japanese nationals in Japan; sex-specific period mortality, national geography. Based on 2024 provisional vital-statistics deaths, 2023-2024 births and 2024 Japanese population estimates. Not foreign nationals or a local-town cohort.

selection.exclusion_reason: Week/month infant subdivisions are retained only in raw because they overlap annual age0. Do not add them to q0.

qx.denominator: life-table survivors at exact age x

Lx.unit_note: The Japanese sheet labels stationary population as persons; the underlying life-table exposure integral is represented here as person-years, not observed people or an event frequency.

Tx.unit_note: The Japanese sheet labels stationary population as persons; the underlying life-table exposure integral is represented here as person-years, not observed people or an event frequency.

ex.unit: expected remaining years under fixed period mortality

sources.missing_policy: The source uses … for unknown/inappropriate-to-display counts. Preserve that marker as null and keep its raw string; an unmarked absent numeric cell is a schema error. All 212 selected rows have every selected value in this snapshot.
limitations: Period table, not an observed birth cohort followed through life
Ages0-104 use annual intervals;105+ is an open final interval
Published counts and probabilities are rounded; arithmetic may differ
No cause of death, diagnosis, recovery or disability status
Male/female are source statistical categories, not personality or family-role rules

license.conditions: Attribute MHLW and source URL, identify this project’s selection/processing, and do not present adaptations as government-authored. Logos and separately restricted content are excluded.

sources.title: Primary school starting age (years), SE.PRM.AGES
sources.release: UIS2026-02; WDI lastupdated2026-10-08; UIS API accessed by WDI2026-03-19
sources.definition: The theoretical age at which pupils enter primary education if they began at the official starting age of the lowest education level and studied full-time without repeating/skipping grades. Mapped to ISCED2011. It is not necessarily the most common actual entry age.
sources.population: National education-system metadata for Japan, Finland and France, reference school years2019-2024. It is not a sampled person-level ratio. Where a school year spans calendar years, the reference is the calendar year in which the school year ends.

selection.denominator_note: Not applicable: theoretical institutional age, not a rate

sources.missing_policy: Keep an explicit API value:null as null with missing_reason=source_null; never infer a nearby year’s value. Preserve obs_status and the empty API unit field; the official glossary supplies unit=Years. All18 selected values are present.
limitations: Not a probability of enrolling at a particular age
Not the compulsory-schooling starting age or preschool age
Not learning readiness, achievement, completion, delay or dropout
A national institutional descriptor does not show local exceptions or individual decisions
